decisive_items: gallium-68 DOTATATE PET/MRI showed a 9×8-mm intracortical lesion in the anterolateral right fibular head
genetic evaluation for hypophosphatemic disorders, including X-linked hypophosphatemia, was unremarkable
response.rationale: Elevated FGF23 with hypophosphatemia and a DOTATATE-avid fibular lesion strongly indicate tumor-induced osteomalacia. X-linked hypophosphatemia was genetically excluded; osteomalacia is a broader syndrome and less specific.

rejected.why: Genetic testing was unremarkable, excluding X-linked hypophosphatemia.
Osteomalacia is the general phenotype, but the specific FGF23-secreting tumor and DOTATATE uptake identify TIO as the precise diagnosis.
